hooks.command: echo 'Cure Consulting Group ProductEngineeringSkills plugin loaded (v7.10.1). 103 skills (domain-organized), 40 agents, 4 personas, 11 rules, 9 output styles. Use /cure-product-engineering:<skill-name> to invoke; full inventory: docs/OVERVIEW.md in the plugin repo. New project? /cure-product-engineering:project-bootstrap.'

python3 -c "
import json, os, sys, time
try:
    base = os.path.expanduser('~/.cure/telemetry')
    os.makedirs(base, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(base, 'sessions.jsonl'), 'a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'ts': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'), 'event': 'session_start', 'project': os.path.basename(os.getcwd()), 'detail': ''}) + chr(10))
except Exception:
    pass
sys.exit(0)" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

echo "Git branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'not a git repo'). Uncommitted changes: $(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '). Last commit: $(git log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo 'none')."

if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && { [ -d .claude ] || [ -d .git ]; }; then PROVISIONED=''; if [ ! -f .claude/loop.md ] && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bootstrap/templates/loop.md" ]; then mkdir -p .claude && cp "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/bootstrap/templates/loop.md" .claude/loop.md && PROVISIONED=".claude/loop.md (Cure maintenance loop — run bare /loop)"; fi; if [ ! -d .claude/workflows ] && [ -d "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/workflows" ]; then mkdir -p .claude/workflows && cp "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/workflows/"*.js .claude/workflows/ 2>/dev/null && PROVISIONED="$PROVISIONED${PROVISIONED:+, }.claude/workflows (/cure-code-audit, /cure-release-check, /cure-migration-sweep)"; fi; if [ -n "$PROVISIONED" ]; then echo "Cure plugin provisioned: $PROVISIONED. Files are yours now — edit freely; existing files are never overwritten."; fi; fi; exit 0

echo 'CONTEXT RE-INJECTION AFTER COMPACTION — Cure Consulting Group standards (always apply):
- Clean Architecture: domain (pure logic) / data (DTOs + repos) / presentation (VMs + UI)
- Android: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt + MVI. iOS: SwiftUI + MVVM + structured concurrency. Web: Next.js App Router + TS strict + Tailwind + Server Components. - SQL: parameterized, timestamptz, reversible migrations. Docker: multi-stage, non-root, pinned. Terraform: remote state + plan before apply.
- Testing: 80% coverage minimum on new code. Security: validate inputs, no hardcoded secrets, parameterized queries.

Plugin: 103 skills, 40 agents, 4 personas — invoke via /cure-product-engineering:<skill>. Full inventory: docs/OVERVIEW.md in the plugin repo.'
echo 'Context compacted. Cure Consulting Group plugin active — 103 skills, 40 agents, 4 personas. Use /cure-product-engineering:<skill-name> to invoke.'

if [ -f scripts/audit-library.py ]; then python3 scripts/audit-library.py --fail-under 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'Skill files changed and the library audit now reports issues — run: python3 scripts/audit-library.py'; fi

hooks.prompt:
A Bash command failed. Tool input and error output: $ARGUMENTS

Classify the failure and name the single most relevant specialized agent, choosing from: ci-debugger (build/test/CI failures), dependency-auditor (dependency or install errors), migration-validator (database/migration errors), deployment-validator (deploy/infra/config errors), or none (transient or trivial — e.g. typo, missing file, permission). Respond with ok: true and put the one-sentence classification plus agent suggestion (or 'no agent needed') in reason.

hooks.prompt:
You are a quality gate reviewing the end of a Claude Code turn. Context: $ARGUMENTS

Decide whether this turn is safe to end. NEVER block automated runs: if this turn is a /loop iteration, a scheduled or maintenance run, a cloud routine, or any turn not driven by a direct user request, return ok: true immediately — blocking an unattended iteration wedges the loop. Otherwise return ok: false ONLY if ALL of these hold: (1) product source code was edited this turn (not just docs, config, markdown, or test files), (2) there is no evidence tests, a build, or a verification command ran after the edits, (3) the user did not explicitly ask to skip verification or defer it, and (4) no quality-gate block has already happened anywhere in this conversation turn — if a prior block or previously delivered blocking reason is visible, return ok: true even if the gap remains, and note the remaining gap in reason instead of blocking again. When returning ok: false, the reason must name the specific files edited and the concrete verification to run. In every other case — including any ambiguity — return ok: true.
